name: Masques and Murder
source:
Revenge!

Your family has been murdered, and the killers will never face justice. But you're just a young woman at court. You can dance, sing, write poetry - but you cannot kill! 

Or can you?
translation: 复仇！你的家人被杀害，凶手却永远不会受到法律制裁。但你只是一名年轻宫廷女子，会跳舞、唱歌、写诗，却不会杀人！还是说，你可以？
